description: Hollow Knight: Silksong item randomizer support for the uploaded BepInEx client.

v0.4.2.description:
### Important

[Made a Trello](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) where I document things that need fixing, things that are done (but might not be in most recent ver yet) and other stuff

When reporting problems please make sure it isn't in the to-fix or long term to-do

### Changelog

- Phantoms cross stich event doesn't softlock anymore
- Added Pollip Heart randomization with six Shellwood checks and six progressive hearts. The Pollip wish now reflects received AP hearts in fresh runs and Pollip Pouch requires all six when the category is randomized
- Added Tool Pouch randomization with four checks and four progressive upgrades. Repeated Crafting Kits, Tool Pouches, Silk Hearts, Claw Mirrors and Curveclaws now maintain their proper progression counts across saves and offline map logic
- Added Restoration of Bellhart as its own QuestSanity check. Also added optional individual relic turn-ins for Scrounge relics and Cardinius cylinders
- Added separate price randomization for shops, Bellways, maps, pins, Needle upgrades and Wish donations. Expensive Shell Shard donations now account for Tool Pouch capacity
- Added the experimental Bone Bottom starting location. Act 2 goal seeds now remove confirmed Act 3-only sources and dependent checks while keeping Silk Soar in the pool as optional post-goal progression
- Flea Hunt now counts all 30 distinct received AP Fleas, including Kratt, Vog and Huge Flea. Goal completion also resynchronizes correctly after saving or reconnecting
- Expanded and tightened room logic across Bone Bottom, The Marrow, Weavenest Atla, Wormways and Deep Docks. Checks with known conservative routes are usable, while genuinely unknown routes remain safely blocked from progression placement
- Corrected many individual access rules, including Grindle, Greymoor Tower Flea, Greymoor Silkeater, Shellwood shard caches, several Memory Lockets and the Bone Bottom statue cache. False Needolin requirements were removed from the Citadel entrance and Cogwork Dancers elevator
- Added the correct Surgeon’s Key requirements for The Unravelled, its Silk Heart and the Underworks Psalm Cylinder. The Psalm Cylinder now uses its real Whiteward route instead of the unrelated Trobbio route
- Fixed physical checks that could remain vanilla, disappear, or fail to report. This includes Pollip Hearts, several inaccessible Shell Shard caches, Mottled Scar Curveclaw and the Hunter’s March and Far Fields necklaces
- The Hunter’s March and Far Fields necklaces are now stationary AP checks that ants cannot carry away. Nearby ordinary rosary caches keep their normal carry-away behavior
- Expanded and corrected map-marker coverage for bosses, Wishes, Tool Pouches, Beast Shards, Pollip Hearts, relic turn-ins and state-dependent shop sources. The Sands of Karak Memory Locket marker and pickup source now point to the correct nook below Watcher at the Edge
- Improved Slab recovery. F4 and every genuine seated bench now restore Hornet’s confiscated cloak, crest, tools and temporary Rosaries and Shell Shards without changing Slab story progression
- Added Naked Trap and improved trap cleanup. Naked Trap can be cleared at a bench, directional input no longer becomes stuck after the trap ends and Stagger Trap uses native recoil without dealing damage
- Fixed post-fight softlocks for The Unravelled and Lace 2 when Hornet has no Silk Hearts. Their existing native recovery branch is now used without granting a free Silk Heart
- Improved memory-fight reliability. Boss checks now trigger at safer victory-only states, while durable AP rewards, DeathLink and resource links survive native memory restoration correctly
- Improved randomized shop previews and item presentation. Shops prefetch the actual AP reward more reliably, Mottled Scar Curveclaw reports the correct check and outgoing items now display an in-game notification
- Crest Slot titles now show Item Name (Player Name) on one readable line. Long player names shrink or ellipsize after the item name and map-marker tooltip text size is configurable
- Improved native inventory synchronization. Physical Bellway purchases unlock their matching destinations, Faydown-only ownership displays the correct cloak and Flea Brew and Plasmium Phial receive one proper initial charge
- Improved several world-state and recovery cases, including Act 3 F4 routing, Cradle map fallback behavior, Wisp Thicket’s randomized Faydown gate, the Moss Mother approach and the Marrow gauntlet’s AP Cling Grip handling
- Updated the bundled companion mods to CrestWheel and Custom Music Randomizer. Fresh Custom Music installs start disabled and its battle handling is safer around arena doors and native fight completion
v0.4.2.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.2

v0.4.2-hotfix.description:
I usually only update once per week but it had some logic bugs that were too severe to ignore

- Gurr the Outcast quest wasn't finishable because Ghillies Doll wasn't something you could pick up
- Logic incorrectly saw the trolley in Marrow as a way to go to Deep Docks despite it needing ot be activated from the right side
- Flea Hunt WinCon now works with fleas in vanilla location
- Zylotol has 2 checks but they were next to each other on the map instead of grouped
- Craggler was missing logic
- Thiefs Mark/Grindle in general cannot be reached with just Silksoar, added Cling Grip as condition until Blasted Steps is fully mapped
- Beast shard rando didn't work until now. Still don't recommend enabling it unless you're a sicko though
v0.4.2-hotfix.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.2 - Hotfix

v0.4.3.description:
I will be taking a break from working on this til Friday as I do have other projects and responsibilities. Do not take these weekly updates for granted as my community and I are working really hard on them so I can only ask to treat it with the patience a non commercial fan-project deserves. There is a [Trello](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) if you want to see what's on the list/what already got done/what's coming but I do these things in bursts whenever time allows me to. Thanks for enjoying this randomizer so far

### Changelog

* Uploaded SilksongRandomizer, CrestWheel and CustomMusicRandomizer to Thunderstore
* Little arrow in F3 menu that lets you switch between Bone Bottom/Bellhart/Songclave as home base (F4 location) as long as you've been there before
* Added Act 1 and Cursed Ending wincons (both need a lot more testing so reports will serve to improve those)
* Option for Vog to give WotH/Foolish/General hints (experimental/still being worked on)
* Loresanity option
* Big update to Shellwood, Bellhart, Sinners Road, Wisp Thicket and Choral Chambers logic
* Several other areas have received a logic overhaul as well

- Added death link cocoon spawn behavior options (vanilla, cocoon, cocoonless)
- Fixed several deathlink related softlocks (entering silkrealm, lace elevator, wish checks being eaten during turn in)
- Flea caravan in Marrow now no longer leave you a choice, Yes and No both send you to Greymoor
- Check names now spell out area first, then item name 
(e.g. Shellwood - Shard Cache 1 instead of Shard Cache 1 - Shellwood)
- Rosary/Shard multiplier option now goes up to 5x and 10x
- Added option to start with map fully drawn
- Added Growstone and Shell Satchel to pool
- With split Swift Step option, enabling early dash only guarantees getting one half early
- Don't auto-switch crest if you do a chapel of a crest you already have
- If you died against Bellbeast, Sherma would be in middle of room during fight
- Act 2 win is not the credits but the final hit on GMS
- A lot more cutscene skipping (pinstress, plimney, etc)
- Sped up a few animations
- Option for in-game markers for melodies and bells to follow the actual checks not their native locations (experimental/so far only functional when zooming in on map)
- Bellsanity actually puts bells for judge door in pool
- There was a spot in Putrified Ducts -> Memorium where the camera locked to a black screen
- Fixed Bellways allowing for purchase to also substitute as AP Bellway ownership
- Volatile Flintbeetles didn't account for whether you can reach all Flintbeetles
- Removed Craggler from boss-sanity. Nobody likes him
- Skai rewrote the README on GitHub. Thank you Skai :)
- The "Victory not able to be created" error is resolved
- Cardinius and the Last Conductor shared one reward template, so load order could make both interactions report the same melody
- Lace 1 check removed for the time being because she pmo (turns out Weavenest Atla and entering Act 2 also deletes her encounter. I'll get back to her in the future)
- Vog and Kratt didn't let you pick up their vanilla loactions if previously received as AP items
- Going to swift step shrine without swift step made the game lie to you and pretend you have it
- Added a Trail’s End requirement option for either Shakra’s 14 purchased map slots or ownership of the 14 map items
- Fixed Ecstasy of the End giving Pale Oil instead of its AP reward and excluded it from Act 1/2/Cursed goals
- Fixed AP-owned Silk Soar not advancing Escape from the Abyss
- Corrected Quick Sling, Loddie, Crawfather and Deep Docks Bellway access logic
- Fixed Greyroot’s cure not restoring crest access
- Skipped the First Sinner memory sequence
- Fixed Fleatopia entering the festival state from the native Egg reward instead of AP Egg ownership
- Prevented nonlethal Shakra spar deaths from triggering DeathLink
- Removed unused item identities, dead location rows and protocol placeholders
- Items in UI were marked as new until native location checked
- Added scuttlebrace_logic (whether the tool should be accounted for in logic), defaulting to false
- LogicUnknown checks remain physically collectable, but considered out of logic with minimal accessibility
- Fixed Shakra repeatedly treating meetings as the first meeting when her initial shop was emptied. Only the exact empty-stock path now records metMapper
